targetMediaRetention.meaning: caption is hidden; its two edge media ranges remain; naturalness is not established

lossless.scope: every retained decoded YUV420p byte and stereo float32 PCM byte, in the specified piece order; before H.264/AAC encoding

base.transform: one native AAC encode of verified background float32 PCM; lossy PCM conversion; MP4 priming preserved; copy audio thereafter

completed.transform: one native AAC encode of verified background float32 PCM; lossy PCM conversion; MP4 priming preserved; copy audio thereafter

newAac.meaning: One AAC encode after verified retained PCM; compare this new base against its Normal-caption output, not against the original full MP4.

exactReplay.observationScope: One actual full-video encode. Decoded frame counts are observed framehash rows only; byte equality does not fabricate decoded or compared frame counts.

finiteState.phaseMeaning: disjoint measured operations; total also includes tool versions and setup
finiteState.frameCountMeaning: verified selected output frames; internal decoder work is not inferred

audibleContinuity: not-evaluated; preserved word observations and editing margins do not prove phonetic safety
